posts.title: Pooch In Action
posts.description: A couple of covers of Pooch in action in the Pacific theatre, fighting with and without Gunner and Sarge, in Our Fighting Forces #63 and #67 (September-October, 1961 and April, 1962), under covers by Jerry Grandenetti .

posts.title: Minutemen In Action
posts.description: A rare glimpse back to the American Revolutionary War, in Our Army At War #13 (August, 1953), under a cover by Bernie Krigstein , with the Minute Men Of Saratoga by Nat Barnett and Bernie Krigstein .

posts.title: Celebrating Artist Ron Randall
posts.description: Celebrating the birthday of artist Ron Randall (November 22, 1956) with a couple of his high flying Airboy covers ( #31 and #32 , from October, 1987) from Eclipse Comics.
